pages.title: HUD
pages.hint: Choose the live match and round counters shown during play.

rows.label: ZSTATS HUD
rows.description: Show the compact ZStats HUD. OFF hides every live row but keeps match tracking and recaps active.

rows.label: HUD POSITION
rows.description: Anchor the stats card to a screen corner. TOP RIGHT matches the default BO3-style layout.

rows.label: HUD SCALE
rows.description: Scale the HUD text and card. Smaller values leave more room for map-authored HUD elements.

rows.label: HUD PRESET
rows.description: Choose MINIMAL for time and zombies, COMPACT for the default four rows, DETAILED for every row, or CUSTOM to use the individual row toggles below.

rows.label: BACKGROUND OPACITY
rows.description: Set the live HUD card background opacity. ZERO keeps the text and orange accent while removing the dark panel.

rows.label: ZSTATS HEADER
rows.description: Show the orange ZSTATS title. OFF removes the title and collapses the extra header spacing.

rows.label: MATCH TIME
rows.description: In CUSTOM preset, show elapsed time since gameplay began for the current match.

rows.label: ZOMBIES LEFT
rows.description: In CUSTOM preset, show active AI plus the stock round spawn queue. Between rounds the HUD shows a dash instead of a misleading count.

rows.label: POINTS PER ROUND
rows.description: In CUSTOM preset, show gross points earned divided by rounds observed since this player joined. This is abbreviated PPR.

rows.label: KILLS PER ROUND
rows.description: In CUSTOM preset, show kills divided by rounds observed since this player joined. This is abbreviated KPR.

rows.label: ROUND TIME
rows.description: In CUSTOM preset, show elapsed time in the current round. Uses an observed stock round start or a valid stock round-start anchor after a late attach.

rows.label: MATCH POINTS EARNED
rows.description: In CUSTOM preset, show gross positive score earned since this player joined, including the initialized starting balance. This remains distinct from spendable points and shows a Career PB after exceeding the saved best match total.

rows.label: ROUND KILLS
rows.description: In CUSTOM preset, show kills gained during the current round and mark a new personal best using the selected PB scope.

rows.label: ROUND POINTS
rows.description: In CUSTOM preset, show gross points earned during the current round and mark a new personal best using the selected PB scope.

rows.label: ROUND HEADSHOTS
rows.description: In CUSTOM preset, show headshot kills gained during the current round and mark a new personal best using the selected PB scope.

rows.label: ROUND REVIVES
rows.description: In CUSTOM preset, show revives made during the current round and mark a new personal best using the selected PB scope. Solo displays N/A.

rows.label: ROUND NUMBER
rows.description: In CUSTOM preset, show the current stock round number as its own aligned row. Career mode marks a new highest round.

rows.label: PERSONAL BEST MARKERS
rows.description: Mark KPR/PPR and completed-round kill, point, headshot, melee, and revive records; Career mode also marks new best match earnings, match kills, and highest round.

pages.title: RECAP
pages.hint: Configure round MVP callouts and the game-over award panel.

rows.label: PERSONAL BEST SCOPE
rows.description: CAREER compares against this client's saved Zombies records across matches. MATCH ONLY resets personal-best comparisons when a new match begins.

rows.label: ROUND PB ANNOUNCEMENT
rows.description: Show a concise client-only message when a completed round sets one or more personal bests. This is separate from the shared Round MVP announcement.

rows.label: ROUND MVP
rows.description: Post one round MVP callout in the game feed, including the category in which that player led the team.

rows.label: GAME OVER AWARDS
rows.description: Show a paginated ZStats recap after the stock scoreboard: personal summary and records in solo, or team awards plus the local player's summary in co-op.

rows.label: SHOW LOWLIGHTS
rows.description: Add a light-hearted Most Downs line to the game-over panel. OFF keeps the default recap entirely positive.

rows.label: RECAP DURATION
rows.description: Total seconds allocated across the ZStats game-over recap pages. ZStats reserves enough time on stock-compatible intermission flows; custom endings may not honor the reservation.
